text_blocks.snippet: Several factors can lower blood pressure, including lifestyle changes and, in some cases, medication. Adopting a heart-healthy diet, increasing physical activity, maintaining a healthy weight, limiting alcohol, and not smoking are key lifestyle modifications that can help. Additionally, certain medications, like diuretics and beta-blockers, can be prescribed to lower blood pressure.
